FLOOR_HINT: Slide, don't lift your feet. Only one foot moves — the other carries your weight.

BABY_STEPS_HINT: Keep steps under your hips — smaller step, better balance.

COOKIE_BANNER_DESC: We use cookies and analytics tools (Google Analytics / GTM) to evaluate training smoothness and enhance the dance guide. You can change your preferences at any time.
MISTAKES_TITLE: 3 Deadly Sins of the Wedding Step

MISTAKES.title: Stork in the Grass
MISTAKES.desc: Lifting your feet high off the floor. Remember: slide the soles along the floor, never lose floor contact!

MISTAKES.title: Seven-League Boots
MISTAKES.desc: Taking overly wide steps. Giant steps ruin balance and drain your stamina. Keep small steps under your hips.

MISTAKES.title: Broomstick Legs
MISTAKES.desc: Locked, stiff knees. All the bounce, groove, and glide in Szuraniec comes from soft, flexing knees!

FOOTER_TEXT: Practice before the wedding, not at the wedding.

LEFT.one: Left foot slides to the left. Weight stays on the right.
LEFT.two: Right foot closes in. Weight transfers to the left.
LEFT.three: Left foot slides again — quick, half a beat.
LEFT.and: Right foot closes on the '&'. Weight stays on the left leg.

RIGHT.one: Right foot slides to the right. Weight stays on the left.
RIGHT.two: Left foot closes in. Weight transfers to the right.
RIGHT.three: Right foot slides again — quick, half a beat.
RIGHT.and: Left foot closes on the '&'. Weight stays on the right leg.

SONG_NAMES.mama: Daj to glosniej — Mama Warned Me
SONG_NAMES.chciala: Ronnie Ferrari — She Wanted it That Way

BREAKDOWN.title: One
BREAKDOWN.body: Leading foot slides sideways. The other one holds your weight.

BREAKDOWN.title: Two
BREAKDOWN.body: Trailing foot closes in. Weight transfers to the leading foot.

BREAKDOWN.title: Three
BREAKDOWN.body: Quick slide of the leading foot — half a beat.
Closing slide on the syncopation. The next bar mirrors it all.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy & Cookies
PRIVACY.SEC_1_TEXT: The administrator of your data is the owner of the dwanajeden.pl domain. The app requires no account creation, allowing fully anonymous training.
PRIVACY.SEC_2_TEXT: To improve training quality, we utilize Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics. Collected data is fully anonymized and used strictly for statistics.
PRIVACY.SEC_3_TEXT: We use cookies for audio engine operation, saving user preferences (e.g. tempo, baby steps mode), and anonymous analytics. You can manage cookies in your browser settings.
PRIVACY.SEC_4_TEXT: We utilize browser Local Storage to maintain technical parameters and app state for a smooth experience without reloading on every refresh.
